job.title: Head of IT Operations and Infrastructure Management
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Head of IT Operations & Infrastructure Management. This opportunity is based in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the strategy, governance, and operational management of the organisation's IT infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available technology services.

Drive infrastructure modernisation, operational excellence, and technology resilience to support critical business operations and future growth.

Key Responsibilities

IT Infrastructure Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute the IT infrastructure roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Establish governance frameworks for IT operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Define and enforce best practices for infrastructure management, cloud computing, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Drive infrastructure transformation initiatives to support organisational growth and digital enablement.

Network & Cloud Management

  • Oversee the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise network architecture.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure environments, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and services.
  • Lead data centre operations, including storage, backup, recovery, and business continuity capabilities.

IT Service Management & Operations

  • Implement IT service management best practices to support efficient and reliable operations.
  • Monitor infrastructure and system performance, identifying optimisation opportunities and operational improvements.
  • Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service disruptions while minimising business impact.
  • Lead technology change and release management activities to ensure smooth implementation of new solutions.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and key partners.
  • Oversee procurement activities, contract management, and service level performance.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure services support organisational priorities.
  • Monitor vendor performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and operations team.
  • Provide technical leadership across infrastructure architecture, cloud services, operations, and technology governance.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Support professional development and capability-building initiatives across the team.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Operations, Cloud Services, or Technology Management roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale infrastructure environments and enterprise technology operations.
  • Strong experience managing technology vendors, commercial agreements, and outsourced service providers.
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex technology initiatives within business-critical environments.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure management, network architecture, and cloud computing.
  • Experience managing data centres, backup and recovery solutions, and business continuity programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database management, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience implementing IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks and operational governance practices.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, ISO/IEC 20000, ISO 22301, ISO 31000, TOGAF, IT Asset Management (ITAM), and related governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with cloud architecture best practices across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience managing infrastructure security, operational resilience, and risk management initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of network technologies, enterprise systems, and high-availability architectures.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and vendor negotiation skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking and decision-making abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management capabilities.
  • Ability to drive transformation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven capability to manage multiple priorities within fast-paced and complex environments.

job.title: Trade Partnerships Manager (BD Manager)
job.description:
Trade Partnerships Manager
 
  • Industry: Business Advisory / Trade & Market Access Solutions
  • Location: Bangkok, Thailand (Monday – Friday, Standard Business Hours)
  • Monthly Base Salary:
    • Manager Level: THB 55,000 – 80,000
    • Senior Manager Level: Up to THB 120,000 (commensurate with 5–8+ years of relevant experience)
  • Total Compensation Package: Basic Salary + 1-Month AWS + Performance Bonus
The Opportunity
Are you an accomplished partnership builder and strategic facilitator skilled in bridging international enterprises with local market ecosystems?
Our client is a premier Business Advisory organization dedicated to enabling cross-border commercial growth, international trade facilitation, and market entry strategy. We are seeking a high-caliber Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Manager to act as the primary catalyst for Asia-based enterprises establishing and scaling their commercial footprint in Thailand.
Note: This is not a direct sales, cold-calling, lead generation, or commission/target-driven commercial role. This strategic facilitation mandate is focused on high-level stakeholder engagement, public-private collaboration, and structuring meaningful, long-term partnerships from exploration through to successful implementation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as the strategic bridge for the new companies across Asia expanding into Thailand, identifying collaboration opportunities and connecting them with credible local partners, joint ventures, and enterprise clients.
  • and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, trade bodies, chambers of commerce, and industry associations across Thailand and the region.
  • Map local industry ecosystems, understand multi-party commercial objectives, identify mutual strategic interests, and facilitate bilateral cooperation agreements.
  • Steer partnership initiatives from initial matchmaking and high-level stakeholder dialogue through to formal execution and practical project implementation.
  • Engage comfortably with C-suite executives, senior government officials, and key community leaders, delivering market insights and strategic alignment.
Key Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Relations, Economics, or related disciplines.
  • Professional Experience:
    • Years of experience in partnership management, business advisory, market entry consulting, or stakeholder relations.
    • Advantage point to a proven leadership in cross-border alliances, public-private partnerships, or ecosystem building.
  • Demonstrated capability in Business-to-Government (B2G) relations, trade associations/chambers engagement, public-private sector collaboration, and strategic partnership lifecycle management. (Exposure to Government-to-Government (G2G) initiatives is a strong plus).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, active listening, and relationship cultivation skills without reliance on aggressive transactional sales techniques.
  • Native or professional fluency in Thai and excellent command of English (both written and spoken) for cross-border corporate and institutional correspondence.
Why This Role Is Attractive
  • Strategic & Institutional Impact: Directly shape cross-border trade and investment corridors between two leading ASEAN economies.
  • High-Altitude Networking: Build an influential network spanning C-level business leaders, key chambers of commerce, and government decision-makers.

job.title: Legal Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Position Title Legal Manager

Job Level Manager

Division CEO office

Reporting to General Counsel, APAC

Job Purpose

Summarize the role /

objective of the job Legal Manager is responsible for overseeing the legal aspects of the company’s operations, ensuring compliance with local and international laws and regulations. This role involves providing strategic legal advice to management, managing legal risks, and overseeing the resolution of legal disputes.

Key Responsibilities

Detail the essential job

duties and job

responsibilities · Legal Strategy Development: Develop and implement legal strategies aligned with the company's business objectives to mitigate legal risks and support growth initiatives. · Contract Management: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts and agreements, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and protecting the company’s interests. · Compliance Oversight: Monitor and ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies across all aspects of the company’s operations. · Corporate Governance and Company Secretary Responsibilities: Serve as Company Secretary, including supporting board and committee meetings, maintaining statutory records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and advising on corporate governance best practices. · Policy Development and Implementation: Develop, review, and update company policies and procedures to ensure compliance with legal requirements and promote ethical behavior within the organization. · Legal Research and Analysis: Conduct legal research on relevant laws, regulations, and industry trends to provide accurate and timely advice to management and other stakeholders. · Regulatory Affairs Management: Serve as the main point of contact for regulatory agencies, manage regulatory submissions and inquiries, and ensure timely compliance with regulatory requirements.

(for recruitment purposes only)

· APAC Center of Excellence Support: Support the APAC Center of Excellence model by coordinating and responding to regional initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and facilitating the implementation of requests and projects driven by the APAC office.

Skills & Competencies

Specific knowledge and

skills that relate to

successful performance in

the job · Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of corporate law, commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, litigation, and other relevant areas of law applicable to the insurance industry. · Strong analytical abilities to assess legal risks, interpret complex legal documents, and provide strategic advice to support business decisions. · Ability to identify legal issues, propose effective solutions, and mitigate risks while balancing legal and business considerations. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively convey complex legal concepts to diverse audiences, including senior management and external stakeholders. · Ability to develop and implement legal strategies aligned with business objectives, anticipating future legal challenges and opportunities. · Flexibility to adapt to changing legal landscapes, business needs, and priorities, ensuring agility in responding to legal challenges.

Qualifications

Field of study and

experiences · Bachelor’s degree in Law is a must. A Master’s degree in Law (LL.M) or a relevant field is preferred. · Minimum of 6-8 years of progressively responsible experience in legal roles within the insurance industry, with a focus on non-life insurance. · In-depth knowledge of insurance laws, regulations, and industry standards applicable to non-life insurance. · Experience in handling legal aspects of insurance product development, distribution, and claims processing. · Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Thai and English. · Strong leadership abilities with experience in managing legal teams and collaborating effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

job.title: [REPLACEMENT] Senior Manager, Accounting and Compliance
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of an insurance and financial services company. Our respective client is looking for a Senior Manager for Accounting who will overseeing the organization’s accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and strong internal controls. The role will be reporting to the company owner with onsite work requirement in Makati City.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
  • Oversee the full spectrum of management accounting functions, including revenue collection, budgeting, and procurement, while ensuring full compliance with regulatory bodies such as the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), Insurance Commission, SEC, and DOLE.
  • Manage and process payroll with strict adherence to confidentiality, accuracy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead, mentor, and supervise junior accounting team members, supporting their daily responsibilities and professional development.
  • Ensure strict compliance with corporate policies, regulatory standards, and internal controls, including the proper maintenance and filing of accounting and compliance documents in both hard and soft copy formats.
  • Supervise accounts payable and receivable functions to ensure accurate and timely processing of transactions.
  • Lead the quarterly and annual closing processes, ensuring accurate preparation of financial statements and reports.
  • Collaborate with team members on account analysis, reconciliations, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Develop, implement, and strengthen accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls to enhance operational efficiency and reporting accuracy.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial analyses and management reports to support strategic decision-making.
Job Requirements:
  • 5+ years of experience in financial controlling.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. CPA is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive and solution-oriented approach toward business issues.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and advanced Excel skills.
  • Comprehensive experience in BIR Tax compliance in the Philippines.
  • Experience in managing payroll, government compliance, and day-to-day office administration.
  • Strong and effective leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • With ability to guide, mentor, motivate, and supervise junior team members effectively.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical abilities with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and advanced Excel skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Willing to work onsite​

job.title: Accounts & HR Executive / Senior Executive
job.description:
Accounts and HR Executive

Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a company that operates in the consumer electronics, wholesale trade, and manufacturing. Our respective client is seeking for an Accounts and HR Executive (1 year contract, renewable) who will be responsible for the day‑to‑day accounting, payroll processing, and statutory compliance activities. This role will ensure accurate financial records, timely payroll administration, and compliance with Philippine tax and labour regulations, while supporting regional finance and HR teams where required. This role has a hybrid work arrangement and will be reporting to Country Head.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
  • Manage the full set of accounts for the Philippine Representative Office, including accounts payable, accruals, prepayments, deposits, journal entries, and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare monthly financial schedules, expense reports, and supporting documentation for management and external advisors.
  • Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and payments in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of required tasks.
  • Liaise with the Head Office Accounts Team, banks, external auditors, legal counsel, and tax agents as required.
  • Manage monthly payroll processing for local employees, including salary calculations, statutory deductions, and payment schedules.
  • Ensure compliance with Philippine statutory requirements, including BIR requirements for withholding tax and compensation reporting, as well as SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG contributions.
  • Prepare and submit payroll-related statutory filings and reports accurately and within prescribed deadlines.
  • Assist with employment contract administration, employee payroll records, and updates to payroll-related information.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes from a payroll and documentation perspective.
  • Coordinate with the Head Office HR Team on payroll, benefits, employee records, and compliance matters.
  • Maintain accurate and organized financial and HR records, ensuring proper filing and documentation.
  • Perform other ad hoc finance, payroll, and administrative duties as assigned.
Job requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, CPA or ACCA certified is required.
  • At least 2 years of experience in accounting and payroll.
  • Working knowledge of Philippine payroll practices and statutory contributions (BIR, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG)
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and payroll processes
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting and preferably payroll systems
  • High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and confidentiality
  • Able to work independently and meet tight deadlines of regional head office
  • Effective communication skills in English preferred

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a growing Pharmaceutical company to hire a Product Manager to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

The Product Manager will be responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of pharmaceutical products, from development to commercialization. This includes managing the product portfolio, strategic planning, market analysis, and working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, regulatory, and R&D teams. The role requires a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical market, strong project management skills, and the ability to drive product success in a competitive environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Planning:
  • Develop and implement product strategies in alignment with overall business goals.
  • Collaborate with senior management to define product positioning, market access strategies, and pricing strategies.
  • Monitor and analyze industry trends, competitor products, and regulatory developments to ensure product success and compliance.
Product Lifecycle Management:
  • Manage the product lifecycle from development to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with R&D and regulatory teams to guide products through development stages, clinical trials, and approvals.
  • Ensure timely product launches by managing timelines, resources, and key stakeholders.
Market Analysis & Consumer Insights:
  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and potential opportunities for product improvement or expansion.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers, sales teams, and healthcare professionals to refine product offerings.
Sales & Marketing Support:
  • Support the development of product positioning and messaging that highlights the product's unique value proposition.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to the sales team to ensure they are equipped to effectively promote the product.
  • Track and analyze product performance, customer feedback, and sales trends to inform future strategies.
Financial Performance & Budgeting:
  • Monitor the financial performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, costs, and profitability.
  • Manage product budgets and collaborate with finance to ensure efficient allocation of resources.
Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business, Marketing or a related field.
  • Experience in the therapeutic area relevant to the Obstetric & Gynaecology or Orthopaedics is preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, brand management, or related roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, product lifecycle management, and market dynamics.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including regulatory, marketing, and sales.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

job.title: Facilities Manager
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting an experienced Facilities Manager to oversee the facilities, construction, renovation, and maintenance requirements on behalf of a leading multinational dialysis service provider. The role will be responsible for in ensuring that both newly developed and acquired dialysis centers are properly constructed, maintained, improved, and operationally ready.

About the Role
The Facilities Manager will oversee both greenfield projects, where the company develops dialysis centers from the ground up, and acquired facilities, where the role will assess existing sites and oversee necessary renovations, repairs, upgrades, and other facility improvements.

The successful candidate must be a licensed or qualified Engineer with strong experience in construction, project management, facilities management, and contractor/vendor management. Experience in managing technical building systems, including MEP, generators, electrical systems, water facilities, and waste management, will be highly advantageous.

Key Responsibilities
Construction & Project Management
  • Oversee the planning, development, construction, fit-out, and completion of greenfield dialysis center projects from the ground up.
  • Manage construction and facility improvement projects, ensuring that timelines, quality standards, budgets, and project requirements are met.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, consultants, and other project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Conduct site inspections and monitor project progress to ensure compliance with approved plans and requirements.
  • Identify and resolve construction, technical, and facilities-related issues that may affect project completion.
Acquired Facility Assessment & Improvements
  • Assess the condition of existing/acquired dialysis centers and identify required repairs, renovations, upgrades, and facility improvements.
  • Develop and oversee improvement plans based on the technical and operational requirements of each site.
  • Manage renovation, repair, fit-out, and rehabilitation works for acquired facilities.
  • Ensure that facilities are safe, functional, compliant, and suitable for ongoing healthcare operations.
Facilities & Technical Management
  • Oversee facilities management requirements across dialysis centers nationwide.
  • Manage and monitor building and facility systems, including:
    • Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems
    • Generators and power-related systems
    • HVAC and other building systems
    • Water supply and water-related facilities
    • Waste management systems
    • General building and facility infrastructure
  • Establish and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance requirements across multiple locations.
  • Ensure facility-related concerns are properly assessed, prioritized, and resolved.
Nationwide & Multi-Site Management
  • Oversee facilities requirements across multiple dialysis centers nationwide.
  • Conduct regular or as-needed field visits to centers within NCR and other locations across the Philippines.
  • Monitor the condition and maintenance requirements of different sites and ensure timely action on facility concerns.
  • Coordinate remotely with site teams, contractors, and service providers to address operational and project requirements.
Vendor & Contractor Management
  • Source, coordinate, and manage contractors, suppliers, and service providers for construction and facilities-related requirements.
  • Negotiate with vendors and contractors to ensure competitive pricing, quality of work, and timely project delivery.
  • Evaluate contractor performance and ensure adherence to agreed project specifications and timelines.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with external contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
Team Management
  • Lead and manage a team of two (2) facilities staff members.
  • Delegate responsibilities and monitor the team's performance and completion of facilities-related activities.
  • Provide guidance and technical support to the team as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • Must be an Engineer, preferably with a relevant engineering degree and professional license.
  • Ideally has approximately 10 years of relevant experience in facilities management, construction, engineering, or project management.
  • Strong experience in construction, fit-out, building development, and project management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects from the ground up, preferably greenfield construction projects.
  • Experience handling existing/acquired facilities, including site assessment, renovation, repair, and facility improvement.
  • Strong technical knowledge of building and facility systems, particularly:
    • MEP systems
    • Electrical systems and generators
    • HVAC
    • Plumbing and water systems
    • Waste management
  • Proven experience managing contractors, suppliers, and vendors, including contract negotiation and project coordination.
  • Experience managing multiple sites or facilities simultaneously.
  • Strong problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Willingness and ability to conduct field visits and travel nationwide as required.
  • Comfortable managing projects and coordinating with contractors and site teams remotely.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and negotiation skills.

job.title: Manager/Asst Manager Sales (Medical Device)
job.description:
Executive recruitment company, Monroe Consulting Malaysia is partnering with a leading global testing, inspection, and certification organization serving medical device and healthcare manufacturers worldwide. The organization provides testing, certification, and regulatory solutions to support product safety, quality, compliance, and international market access. The company is now looking to hire an Assistant Manager/Manager, Sales (Medical Device).

This role will be responsible for driving business growth by developing new accounts, managing key clients, and promoting testing and certification solutions across the medical device sector.

Job Responsibilities: 

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across medical device manufacturers and healthcare companies.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers and strategic partners.
  • Promote testing and certification services covering areas such as microbiology, biocompatibility, electrical safety, EMC, cybersecurity, and sustainability.
  • Drive certification solutions including ISO 13485, EU MDR, MDSAP, and Malaysian local schemes.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Expand the customer base and grow existing accounts through consultative selling.
  • Conduct client visits, presentations, networking activities, and industry events.
  • Travel within Malaysia as required to meet customers and develop business opportunities.
Job Requirements: 
  • Degree in Engineering, Biomedical, Medical Technology, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of B2B sales or business development experience, preferably in an international environment.
  • Proven track record in new business development, account growth, and consultative selling.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand and communicate technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and networking skills.
  • Driven, resilient, and quick to learn technical concepts.
  • Willingness to travel within Malaysia for client meetings and events.
  • Experience in medical devices, healthcare, testing, certification, or regulatory services will be an advantage.

job.title: Operations Manager (WWI)
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a company that focuses on trading, importing and finishing of building materials. Our respective client is seeking for an Operations Manager who will be responsible for overseeing and integrating the company’s end-to-end operations, ensuring alignment with executive objectives, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth. The role serves as a key liaison to senior management and provides strategic direction across logistics, supply chain, sales operations, customer service, and administration. This role has an onsite and field work requirement in Mandaue City, Cebu and will be reporting to the COO and CEO.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
  • Executive & Operational Governance: Partner with company executives to translate business strategies into actionable operational plans, provide performance updates and recommendations, and oversee the implementation of key policies and initiatives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and align department heads and supervisors across Warehouse & Logistics, Sales & Showrooms, Purchasing/Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Administration to achieve shared business goals and operational standards.
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Management: Oversee warehousing, inventory management, material flow, fulfilment, and logistics activities for projects, distributors, showrooms, and direct clients while ensuring timely and quality delivery.
  • Performance & Process Improvement: Establish and monitor KPIs, operational costs, lead times, and resource utilization. Identify process gaps, eliminate operational waste, reduce costs, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance: Drive adherence to SOPs, QMS standards, safety requirements, statutory regulations, and corporate policies. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions to address recurring operational issues.
  • People & Resource Management: Lead, mentor, and evaluate managers and supervisors while overseeing manpower planning, resource allocation, and capacity requirements to support business growth and operational continuity.
  • Stakeholder & Issue Management: Promote cross-departmental accountability, resolve operational conflicts, and ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues that may impact customers, profitability, or business performance.


Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in any Business-related courses. Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 10 years of experience in operations with 5 years in leadership capacity.
  • Proven track record in managing multi-channel operations (B2B Projects, Wholesale, Retail, Supply Chain) within the furnishing, finishing materials, construction, or interior fit-out industry
  • Excellent ability to communicate, negotiate, and align with Business Owners and top management.
  • Deep expertise in end-to-end supply chain, warehouse management, project logistics, and inventory control systems (ERP/WMS).
  • Strong decision-making capability, change management skills, and crisis leadership.

job.title: Junior Enterprise Sales Executive (Software / SaaS)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Junior Enterprise Sales Executive. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Support the growth of the enterprise sales function by identifying new business opportunities, engaging prospective clients, and contributing to complex sales cycles.

Work closely with cross-functional teams to drive customer acquisition, strengthen client relationships, and support business growth across key markets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Pipeline & Prospecting

  • Identify, research, and qualify enterprise prospects across multiple industries.
  • Conduct outreach through email, social platforms, events, and calls to generate new business opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information and pipeline visibility within CRM platforms.

Sales Support & Deal Execution

  • Support senior sales leaders in managing enterprise opportunities from qualification through to contract completion.
  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, business cases, and solution summaries.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth progression of sales opportunities.
  • Participate in discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and customer workshops where required.

Customer Engagement

  • Understand customer challenges, objectives, operational processes, and procurement requirements.
  • Assist in preparing tailored demonstrations and value-driven presentations.
  • Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with prospects and customers.

Market & Product Knowledge

  • Stay updated on product offerings, market developments, and competitive activities.
  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise software buying cycles, including procurement, compliance reviews, proof-of-concepts, and budgeting processes.
  • Share customer feedback and market insights with relevant internal teams.

Reporting & Administration

  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports.
  • Track sales KPIs including lead generation, pipeline coverage, opportunity volume, and conversion metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with internal sales processes and governance standards.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in software sales, technology sales, SaaS, business development, or a related commercial role.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and customer acquisition activities.
  • Exposure to B2B or enterprise customers within Malaysia or the wider Southeast Asian region is advantageous.
  • Based in Kuala Lumpur or willing to relocate.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Familiarity with enterprise sales processes, software procurement, RFPs, vendor onboarding, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and commercial pricing models.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar tools.
  • Ability to understand technology solutions and communicate business value effectively.
  • Exposure to solution selling, technical scoping, or customer demonstrations is an advantage.
  • Understanding of subscription-based business models, software licensing, renewals, or recurring revenue environments is preferred.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage managers, directors, and senior stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with a strong desire to develop a career in enterprise sales.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving abilities.
  • Customer-centric mindset with a consultative approach to selling.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Strong organisational and relationship management skills.

job.title: PERM Director of Resident Care - RN - Assisted Living Facility
job.description:
Director of Resident Care - RN - Assisted Living Facility
Du Lac Assisted Living Worcester, MA
Description
 
Director of Resident Care - RN Licensed Registered Nurse Required Notre Dame du Lac Assisted Living Worcester, MA
Student Loan Repayment and Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 /year; federal tax-exempt 

Who We Are: 
Notre Dame Health Care Center, Inc. (NDHCC) deeply rooted in the heritage of the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur, is committed to the physical, spiritual, and emotional care of our residents and patients. Located off the shores of Lake Quinsigamond within the woods of the Worcester Land Trust, our 5 Star rated nationally recognized Assisted Living, Skilled Nursing Care, Hospice Care, and Educational Bridge Center provide high-quality compassionate care to the Central MA community. 

Position Overview: 
Adhering to NDHC’s mission and values, the Resident Care Director directs the delivery of all resident care while maintaining compliance with state, federal guidelines. Responsibilities include the following: supervision and development of department employees, care management, serve as member of organizations management team, development of strategic planning and quality assurance initiatives. This role directly supervises, motivates and encourages all resident care staff. An unwavering focus on customer service and resident and family relations are critical. The Director will lead by example with unwavering customer service demonstrated by healthy and thriving resident and family relationships. 

Work Hours and Schedule Expectations: 
Typical workday hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:00PM.
Employee within this position not expected to work paid holidays. 
Position is ultimately responsible for the Resident Care Department 24 hours a day.

Requirements
· Graduate of an accredited school of nursing (RN), BS preferred 
· Current/Nursing license in the state of Massachusetts 
· A minimum of five years of clinical experience, working with memory care and assisted living residents.  
· Ability to work well with other professionals and communicate effectively. 
· Proven leadership skills from past employment professional organizations. 
· Knowledge/ Understanding of EOEA regulations required. 
· Knowledge of professional nursing theory and practice needed to give and evaluate resident care. 
· Knowledge of organizational policies, regulations, and procedures to administer resident care. 
· Knowledge of medical equipment and instruments to administer resident care. 
· Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to establish a safe work environment. 
· Skill in applying and modifying the principles, methods, and techniques of professional nursing to provide on-going resident care. 
· Skill in preparing and maintaining resident records, writing reports, and responding to correspondence. 
· Skill in developing and maintaining department quality assurance 
· Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with residents, medical staff, and the public. 
· Ability to maintain quality control standards 
· Knowledge of budget process 
· Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations 
· Ability to interpret, adapt, and apply guidelines and procedures 
· Ability to communicate clearly (both verbally and in writing) in English

job.title: Head of Compliance
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is representing a leading organization within the asset management and capital markets sector in its search for an experienced Head of Compliance to lead its compliance function in Jakarta.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a compliance professional with strong capital market expertise, direct regulatory exposure and the ability to operate as a trusted advisor to the Board and senior management.

The Role

As Head of Compliance, you will be responsible for leading the organization's compliance framework and ensuring adherence to applicable investment management and capital market regulations.

You will also play a key role in maintaining relationships with Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK), advising senior stakeholders on regulatory matters and ensuring the organization maintains a strong culture of compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the overall Compliance function and team.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable investment management and capital market regulations.
  • Manage engagement with OJK, including regulatory reporting, inspections, inquiries and follow-up on findings.
  • Oversee the organization's AML / APU-PPT framework.
  • Provide oversight of transaction monitoring and suitability processes.
  • Support product governance from a regulatory and compliance perspective.
  • Lead regulatory audits, inspections and remediation of regulatory findings.
  • Provide practical regulatory and compliance advice to the BOD and senior management.
  • Partner closely with Risk, Audit, Legal and Business functions.
  • Strengthen compliance processes, controls and organizational capability.
  • Develop and lead a high-performing Compliance team.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Compliance, Risk or Audit.
  • At least 5 years of experience in Asset Management / Capital Markets.
  • Proven direct experience dealing with OJK.
  • Current or recent experience at Head, VP or equivalent senior management level.
  • Proven experience leading a team or compliance function.
  • Strong knowledge of investment management and capital market regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with AML / APU-PPT requirements.
  • Experience across several of the following areas:
    • Regulatory reporting
    • Transaction monitoring
    • Suitability processes
    • Product governance
    • Regulatory audits / inspections
    • Regulatory findings and remediation
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance regulatory requirements with commercial and business considerations.

Candidates from Asset Management, Securities / Investment Banking or Custodian Banking environments are particularly encouraged to apply.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take a senior leadership position within the asset management sector, with direct exposure to the Board, senior management and regulatory stakeholders, while playing a key role in strengthening the organization's compliance and governance framework.

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
Function: Compliance / Risk
Level: Head / VP

job.description:

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Procurement Manager. This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor.
Position Overview
Lead the organisation's procurement function across metal, non-metal, and import logistics categories while ensuring cost-effective and reliable supply management.
Drive operational excellence, supplier performance, risk mitigation, and strategic sourcing initiatives that support the organisation's business objectives and long-term growth.
Key Responsibilities
• Responsible for all procurement activities (Metal, Non Metal and Import Logistics).
• Develop and formulate strategies on commodities and non-commodities procurement in line with company’s objective and focus.
• Minimize risk exposure in supply and service contracts and maximize opportunities in operations through supplier management.

• Lead and develop high-performing purchasing and cost estimating teams to achieve objectives and drive continuous improvement.
• Lead and to ensure all purchases are manage via best practices according to Corporate, Company and Government Policies and to the best interest of the company and its stakeholders.

• Candidate must possess at least Bachelor's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Professional Degree in Business Management, Operation Management, Logistic/Transportation or equivalent.

• Experience managing procurement activities across Metal, Non Metal and Import Logistics categories.

• Planning Skills.

• Leadership Skills.

• Strong knowledge of automated logistics systems, material flow technologies, and solution costing.

• Proficiency in CAD and MS Office.

• Strong customer-centric thinking.

job.title: Marketing and Communications Copywriter
job.description:
Marketing and Communications Copywriter

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services industry to hire a Marketing and Communications Copywriter. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Marketing and Communications Copywriter plays a vital role in strengthening the organisation's position as a leader in its sector through strategic, high-quality communications and content creation.

The role contributes to preserving and enhancing the organisation's culture, reputation, and brand presence by delivering engaging content across multiple communication channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Integration: Collaborating with the Content Specialist and the Advancement team to integrate all social media and digital content plans with overall marketing and advancement objectives.
  • Marketing and Advancement Copywriting: Writing clear, persuasive copy for admissions, marketing, and advancement materials, including brochures, advertisements (print and digital), landing pages, and marketing campaigns.
  • Long-Form Digital Development: Developing high-quality, long-form content for the school's website, blog (e.g., educational thought leadership), email newsletters (EDMs), and admissions-focused email campaigns.
  • Platform-Specific Social Media Creation: Creating engaging, platform-specific copy, posts, and captions for all official school social media channels (e.g., Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok).
  • Content Calendar Management: Developing and managing a daily social media content calendar that strategically aligns content with school events, admissions cycles, and key content pillars (e.g., academic excellence, student life, alumni success).
  • Authentic Community Storytelling: Proactively sourcing, capturing, and generating authentic, in-the-moment content, including developing short-form video scripts (Reels/Stories) and photo captions, highlighting the student and faculty experience.
  • Quality Control and Proofreading: Serving as the final quality control for all public-facing text, meticulously proofreading and editing to ensure impeccable grammar, adherence to brand style guides, and complete factual accuracy.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensuring all social media content strictly complies with school privacy policies regarding student, employee, and community members' photo/video usage.
  • Other Duties: Performing other related duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field.
  • Preferably with at least 5 years of related experience.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • High-quality writing and content production delivered with speed and precision, demonstrating the ability to quickly grasp and produce content across diverse subject areas.
  • Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills in English with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Skilled at tailoring written communication to meet the needs of diverse audiences with varying levels of language proficiency and subject expertise.
  • Significant experience in writing in various formats and for a range of techniques under the PR/content umbrella, including social media, blogs, advertorials, newsletters, video scripts, media releases, and feature stories.
  • Knowledge of media production, communication, and dissemination techniques and methods. This includes alternative ways to inform and entertain via written, oral, and visual media.
  • Extensive experience in using automated marketing platforms, email marketing services, social media management, and optimisation platforms.
  • Understanding of PDPA requirements related to marketing and digital communications.
  • Experience in creating content for websites, blogs, EDMs, social media channels, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and corporate communication assets.
  • Understanding of SEO techniques and content optimisation.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Social Chameleon: The ability to switch tones effortlessly, from interviewing a Middle School student to a senior faculty member or responding to a concerned parent online.
  • Empathy & Inclusivity: A warm personality that makes people feel comfortable being filmed or photographed, with a strong appreciation for diversity and inclusion in an international setting.
  • Strategic Anticipation: Ability to pivot quickly when a storytelling opportunity arises, managing the tension between a fixed schedule and a fast-moving environment.
  • Critical Observation: Ability to identify compelling stories and content opportunities.
  • Brand Stewardship: A sharp eye for brand voice and the ability to determine whether content aligns with brand standards.
  • Prioritisation: Strong judgement to determine which tasks require immediate attention and which can be scheduled for later.
  • Stakeholder Diplomacy: Ability to follow up on approvals or content requests effectively while maintaining positive working relationships.
  • Feedback Resilience: Ability to accept creative feedback from multiple stakeholders and incorporate it constructively into the final output.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills with the ability to engage a diverse range of stakeholders.

Product Discovery & Requirements Definition

Feature Delivery & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with Engineering and technical teams to drive features from concept through release.

  • Track feature-level KPIs and provide updates to product leadership.

Customer & Market Insights

  • Partner with commercial and delivery teams to capture customer and market feedback.

Product Operations & Governance

  • Maintain product roadmaps, release calendars, and decision logs.

Commercial & Go-to-Market Support

  • Support solution scoping activities and product demonstrations.

  • Feed customer and deployment insights back into the product roadmap.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation technologies.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into structured product artefacts, including PRDs, user stories, and roadmap initiatives.

  • Experience supporting product discovery, requirements gathering, and feature delivery.
  • Knowledge of product analytics tools; SQL exposure is an advantage.
  • Understanding of enterprise software, workflow automation, analytics platforms, or digital transformation solutions.
  • Exposure to user research, product launches, go-to-market initiatives, or UI/UX principles is beneficial.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to balance customer requirements, business goals, and technical considerations.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive and continuous learning mindset.

job.title: Construction Engineer - Post-tensioned building or bridge projects
job.description:
Job Role: Construction Engineer
Responsibilities:
  • Handle site operations, including planning project work schedules and controlling project costs.
  • Assist Managers and Senior Engineers in preparing Site Activity Reports (SAR) and prepare bi-weekly or monthly Progress Reports for submission.
  • Conduct resource planning for manpower, materials, and equipment required for the project.
  • Liaise with clients on-site regarding work-related matters.
  • Review shop drawings from the Design Department and clients to address any on-site construction issues.
  • Troubleshoot on-site problems to minimize delays and reduce additional costs.
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards and assist in coordinating inspections and documentation within assigned site scopes.
  • Support the Site Manager in identifying non-conformities and assisting in their resolution with reference to project specifications.
  • Provide technical and practical support to Supervisors and Foremen during construction activities.
  • Monitor material wastage and on-site productivity to reduce wastage.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s IMS processes and procedures.
  • Conduct OSH risk assessment and implement EMS impact & aspect registers.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of all construction-related site activities, including work progress, resource usage, and daily operations.
  • Ensure that relevant QA/QC documents (e.g., inspection reports, test results) are completed and submitted as part of regular site reporting.
  • Carry out procurement of materials and equipment in accordance with company policies and delegated authority.
  • Coordinate the delivery, retrieval, and inter-site transfer of materials and equipment to and from project sites and storage facilities. Ensure all transactions are properly documented using the relevant delivery and material transfer forms.
  • Maintain accurate documentation related to construction activities, including delivery records, material transfer forms, permits, inspections, technical reports, and monthly stock take reports.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.
  • Must be a Licensed Civil Engineer.
  • At least three (3) years of relevant experience in post-tensioned building or bridge projects is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Independent, resourceful, diligent, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willing to be assigned to project sites anywhere in the Philippines as required.

job.title: Senior Area Sales Manager
job.description:
Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg

Location: Malaysia

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment Firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the growth and commercial performance of the company's egg business unit by developing business opportunities, driving sales strategies, and strengthening market presence across the region.
This role plays a critical part in achieving revenue, profitability, and market share objectives while supporting product development, customer engagement, and regional collaboration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the Company's Egg sales-related activities including developing new business, growth strategies and opportunities and maximising long-term profitable volume growth.
  • Realise sales budget (target) both in volume, margin and market share.
  • Analyse the market and determine the sales strategy including a market-specific pricing policy.
  • Participate in generating "Proven Solutions", sales manuals, product and solution templates for proposals, meetings, workshops and other specific sales material.
  • Recommend and take part in trade shows and other relevant marketing projects.
  • Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service and manage key client relationships.
  • Recommend and implement detailed annual sales operating plans and preparation of sales performance reports for strategic analysis and review on a monthly or quarterly basis.
  • Collect and share product ideas/market requirements. Actively participate in the design of BU Egg related products in collaboration with the customer solutions, engineering and HQ.
  • Assist in the roll out of new products to the relevant countries in our region.
  • Assist and lead the project sales with consulting on farm management level.
  • Determine training requirements for BU Egg sales team.
  • Liaise with respective Asia regions to conduct BU Egg product trainings regionally.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Animal Production or any other equivalent qualification.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Proven ability to develop new business, growth strategies and market opportunities.
  • Experience in achieving sales budgets covering volume, margin and market share targets.
  • Strong market analysis and sales strategy development capabilities, including pricing strategy formulation.
  • Experience in developing sales materials, solution proposals, sales manuals and product templates.
  • Ability to prepare detailed annual sales operating plans and sales performance reports for strategic review.
  • Experience in product development collaboration with customer solutions, engineering and head office stakeholders.
  • Exposure to new product rollout initiatives across multiple countries.

  • Knowledge of training needs assessment and sales capability development programmes.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent networking and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive and able to work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills with evidence of building, retaining and motivating a high-performing sales team.

job.title: Regional Product Support Engineer – Electronic
job.description:
Regional Product Support Engineer – Electronic

Location: Malaysia

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment Firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Regional Product Support Engineer – Electronic based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

Provide regional technical expertise and product support across a diverse portfolio of electronic systems, controllers, sensors, and automation technologies.
This role is instrumental in ensuring product reliability, supporting innovation, driving technical improvements, and enabling operational excellence across the region.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Product and Technical Support

  • Act as the regional technical expert for Product Component Category 09 & 10 (Electronic Components, Computer and Controller).
  • Provide technical support across the regional electronic product portfolio, including computer and controller systems, sensors and cameras, egg counters, measurement applications, power and energy systems, and related control and alarm devices.
  • Diagnose complex hardware, software, communication, configuration, and integration issues in cooperation with service and engineering teams.
  • Support commissioning, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management of electronic products in the field.
  • Translate recurring field issues into clearly documented technical requirements and improvement proposals.
  • Deliver technical training to other relevant stakeholders if required.

2. Software, Computer, Controller, and Electronic Product Expertise

  • Provide technical support to commissioning teams when they encounter issues during the application, configuration, commissioning, or troubleshooting of computer and controller systems, software and licences, sensors and cameras, egg counters, measurement applications, power and energy systems, alarm devices, and related electronic components.
  • Support commissioning teams in resolving technical issues related to the integration of electronic products with climate, feeding, ventilation, weighing, egg-counting, alarm, emergency-opening, and other farm-management systems.
  • Support software and firmware validation, release testing, regression testing, licence verification, and field verification.

3. Cost Reduction and Alternative Solutions

  • Lead and support cost-down initiatives for electronic systems, controllers, sensors, cables, interfaces, and related components.
  • Search and technically assess alternative electronics solutions from qualified suppliers outside the existing product ecosystem.
  • Compare alternative solutions based on functionality, reliability, compatibility, cybersecurity considerations, supply security, serviceability, regulatory requirements, and total cost.
  • Support supplier evaluation, technical clarification, sample procurement, and implementation planning.

4. Testing, Trials, and Validation

  • Coordinate pilot installations and alternative-component trials with regional teams, farms, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Collect, analyse, and report test and trial results using objective technical and commercial criteria.
  • Verify the performance of alternative components under realistic farm conditions, including temperature, humidity, dust, vibration, electrical interference, and continuous operation.
  • Support controlled product releases and rollout plans following successful validation.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the Global Electronics Team, R&D, product management, purchasing, quality, software engineering, project execution, technical service, and regional subsidiaries.
  • Coordinate calibration activities, technical alignment, and knowledge sharing with the Global Electronics Team.
  • Represent regional product-support requirements in global product and technology discussions.
  • Coordinate technical communication between internal teams and external suppliers.
  • Participate in product reviews, design reviews, root-cause analyses, and continuous-improvement activities.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent professional qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automation, or Mechatronics.
  • 5+ years of practical experience with industrial electronics, automation systems, embedded controls, agricultural technology, building automation, or comparable equipment.
  • Experience supporting controllers, PLCs, embedded systems, sensors, communication networks, or software-based control systems.
  • Demonstrated experience in testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, product validation, or field trials.
  • Experience with supplier evaluation, component qualification, product improvement, or cost-reduction projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience working in an international, cross-functional, or regional support environment is an advantage.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong understanding of electronic control systems, sensors, actuators, signal processing, wiring, power supplies, and industrial communication interfaces.
  • Practical knowledge of controller configuration, software/firmware behaviour, diagnostics, and data communication.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, product hierarchies, and system documentation.
  • Working knowledge of structured testing, root-cause analysis, failure analysis, and risk-based validation.
  • Expertise in commissioning, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management of electronic products.
  • Experience supporting software and firmware validation, release testing, regression testing, licence verification, and field verification.
  • Ability to assess alternative electronics solutions based on functionality, reliability, compatibility, cybersecurity considerations, supply security, serviceability, regulatory requirements, and total cost.
  • Experience coordinating pilot installations, trials, validation activities, and product rollouts.
  • Familiarity with climate, feeding, ventilation, weighing, egg-counting, alarm, emergency-opening, and farm-management system integration.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to distinguish between hardware, software, configuration, installation, and environmental causes of failure.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Effective technical communication and knowledge-sharing capabilities.
  • Ability to coordinate with regional and global teams across multiple functions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a structured approach to root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Capability to deliver technical training and support to relevant stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively within a matrix and international environment.

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services industry to hire a General Manager – Retail. This opportunity is based in Sarawak.
Position Overview
The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall management and operations of a retail complex, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations and service excellence.
This role plays a critical part in driving financial performance, tenant satisfaction, operational efficiency, and long-term asset value.
Key Responsibilities
  • Financial Management: Oversee the financial performance of the retail centre, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Tenant Management: Manage relationships with tenants, negotiate leases, and ensure tenant satisfaction.
  • Building Management: Ensure the efficient and safe operation of the retail centre, including maintenance, repairs, and security.
  • Marketing and Events: Develop and implement marketing strategies to attract and retain customers, and organize events and promotions.
  • Customer Service: Foster a positive and welcoming environment for customers, ensuring exceptional customer service.
  • Administration: Manage administrative tasks, including HR, IT, and legal compliance.
  • Staff Management: Recruit, train, and develop a high-performing team of staff.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Property Management/Real Estate, Retail Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in retail management or operations, with at least 10 years in a leadership role.
  • A combination of strong leadership and business acumen with experience in budget management and reporting.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Tenant relationship management and lease negotiation.
  • Retail centre operations management, including maintenance, repairs, and security oversight.
  • Marketing strategy development and execution.
  • Event and promotional planning and management.
  • Customer service management.
  • Administration across HR, IT, and legal compliance functions.
  • Staff recruitment, training, and development.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels.
  • Proven ability to lead and inspire a diverse team, fostering a culture of excellence.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions under pressure.

job.title: Physical Distribution Assistant Manager - Visayas & Mindanao
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading producer of quality baked products in the country. Our client is looking for a Physical Distribution Assistant Manager – Visayas & Mindanao to oversee and optimize warehouse and transportation operations across the region, ensuring efficient product movement, inventory accuracy, cost-effective distribution, and high service levels.

This is an onsite position, Monday to Saturday, based in Cagayan de Oro City (CDO).

Physical Distribution Assistant Manager – Visayas & Mindanao

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the planning, coordination, and supervision of warehouse and transportation activities across Visayas and Mindanao.
  • Monitor inventory levels, identify stock discrepancies, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure efficient movement and timely delivery of finished goods from warehouses to customers and distribution points.
  • Liaise closely with Procurement, Production, Sales, and other relevant teams to ensure a seamless flow of goods.
  • Oversee the performance of third-party logistics (3PL) providers and ensure compliance with agreed service levels and operational standards.
  • Monitor logistics costs and identify opportunities to improve distribution efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
  • Analyze distribution, inventory, and transportation data and provide actionable recommendations to management.
  • Lead, coach, and develop warehouse and logistics personnel to achieve operational and service-level objectives.
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for warehouse and distribution operations.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and relevant health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across physical distribution operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • More than 5 years of experience in physical distribution, logistics, or warehouse management, preferably within the manufacturing or FMCG industry.
  • Strong experience in warehouse operations, transportation management, inventory control, and 3PL management.
  • Experience managing and developing logistics or warehouse teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Good understanding of distribution KPIs, logistics costs, and operational efficiency.
  • SAP experience is highly preferred.
  • Willing to be based onsite in Cagayan de Oro City and work Monday to Saturday.

job.title: Quality Department Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading producer of quality baked products in the country. Our client is looking for a Quality Department Manager to lead quality assurance operations, ensure food safety and regulatory compliance, and drive continuous improvement across production processes.

This is an onsite position, Monday to Friday, with the office located in Meycauayan, Bulacan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve quality assurance systems and procedures.
  • Monitor production processes and address quality issues.
  • Conduct quality audits and inspections to ensure compliance with company and industry standards.
  • Analyze quality data and recommend process improvements.
  • Lead, train, and develop the Quality Assurance team.
  • Collaborate with Production, Procurement, and R&D teams to resolve quality concerns.
  • Stay updated on food safety regulations, industry trends, and best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Quality Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of food safety management systems and regulatory requirements.
  • Certifications in HACCP, ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, or ISO 22000 are preferred.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Demand Planning Manager
job.description:
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business, Operations, or a related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Forecasting, or Supply Chain Planning.
Industry experience in food manufacturing/FMCG is required.
Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory planning, and S&OP processes.
Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Production, and Supply Chain teams.
Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with ERP/planning systems.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability and willingness to build a function and team from the ground up.

JOB SUMMARY:
The Demand Planning Manager will lead the company’s demand planning and S&OP processes, ensuring alignment across Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Finance. This position will also drive cross-functional planning, manage supply constraints and disruptions, and ensure production and inventory plans effectively support commercial demand. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in demand forecasting, S&OP, and end-to-end supply planning within a manufacturing environment.

job.title: Manufacturing Excellence Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading producer of quality baked products in the country. Our client is looking for a Manufacturing Excellence Manager to lead production excellence initiatives, optimize manufacturing processes, and ensure efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective bakery operations.

This is an onsite position, Monday to Saturday, with the office located in Meycauayan, Bulacan.

Manufacturing Excellence Manager

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement production strategies aligned with business objectives and manufacturing targets.
  • Forecast production requirements based on sales trends, customer demand, and business projections.
  • Optimize production capacity, manpower, equipment, and other resources to maximize operational efficiency.
  • Oversee daily cake and bakery production operations to ensure smooth and timely execution.
  • Ensure production targets are consistently achieved while maintaining safety, quality, and efficiency standards.
  • Monitor production workflows and identify opportunities to improve productivity, minimize downtime, and reduce waste.
  • Ensure all products meet established quality standards and customer expectations.
  • Establish production KPIs, monitor performance, and conduct regular employee evaluations.
  • Identify production bottlenecks and implement Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Drive process improvements focused on productivity, cost efficiency, waste reduction, and overall manufacturing excellence.
  • Participate in new product trials and support the successful commercialization and scale-up of new cake and bakery products.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP, HACCP, food safety standards, and relevant manufacturing regulations.
  • Collaborate with Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other functions to resolve production issues and improve overall plant performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
  • More than 5 years of experience in bakery or food manufacturing, with at least 3 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
  • Strong experience in production management, process improvement, and manufacturing operations.
  • Knowledge of GMP, HACCP, food safety, and Lean Manufacturing principles.
  • Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, KPI management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage high-volume production operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing to work onsite, Monday to Saturday, in Meycauayan, Bulacan.
