job.title: Business Development Manager - MVR
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Business Development Manager - MVR. This opportunity is based in Southeast Asia & Oceania.
Position Overview
Lead the growth and market expansion of Mechanical Vapor Recompression (MVR) systems across Southeast Asia and Oceania through strategic business development, solution selling, and project leadership.
Drive the adoption of sustainable evaporation and process efficiency solutions while delivering commercial growth, successful project execution, and long-term customer value.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Market Expansion
  • Drive regional business growth for Mechanical Vapor Recompression systems across Southeast Asia and Oceania.
  • Identify priority markets, applications, and customer segments where MVR delivers strong sustainability, energy-saving, and process-efficiency value.
  • Develop and execute a focused go-to-market strategy for industries such as chemical processing, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, solvent recovery, wastewater treatment, and Zero Liquid Discharge applications.
  • Build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities through direct customer engagement, channel collaboration, EPC partnerships, and internal network development.
  • Position MVR as a strategic solution for customers seeking lower operating costs, reduced steam dependency, improved water recovery, and lower CO₂ footprint.
2. Strategic Customer & Project Engagement
  • Engage with senior customer stakeholders, plant managers, process engineers, consultants, EPCs, and decision-makers to understand process challenges and translate them into value-based MVR solutions.
  • Lead technical-commercial discussions, feasibility reviews, application assessments, and solution positioning.
  • Build long-term relationships with strategic accounts and high-potential customers across the region.
  • Support complex negotiations by articulating lifecycle value, payback potential, reliability benefits, and sustainability impact.
3. Project Execution Leadership
  • Take ownership of opportunities from early concept through proposal, order intake, execution, delivery, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate closely with engineering, operations, supply chain, service, application specialists, and regional sales teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Act as the key business owner for MVR projects, ensuring alignment between customer expectations, technical scope, commercial commitments, and internal execution capability.
  • Monitor project milestones, risks, customer communication, and handover quality to ensure a professional and reliable customer experience.
4. Commissioning & Implementation Oversight
  • Oversee the commissioning process together with technical and service teams to ensure successful start-up, performance validation, and customer satisfaction.
  • Support troubleshooting, application optimization, and lessons learned to continuously improve future project execution.
  • Ensure that installed systems become strong references for future business development and regional market confidence.
5. Internal Collaboration & Capability Building
  • Work closely with regional sales teams, distributors, service teams, product companies, engineering centers, and management to build MVR capability across the region.
  • Train and support internal stakeholders on MVR applications, customer value propositions, qualification criteria, and commercial positioning.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitor insights, customer feedback, and application trends to support product and business strategy.
  • Contribute to business planning, forecasting, pipeline governance, and strategic reviews.
6. Commercial Performance & Business Ownership
  • Own the regional MVR opportunity pipeline and drive disciplined follow-up through CRM and structured review processes.
  • Deliver growth in orders, revenue, profitability, market share, and reference installations.
  • Develop business cases and investment recommendations for strategic opportunities, partnerships, or capability gaps.
  • Ensure that projects are pursued with strong commercial discipline, technical feasibility, and long-term customer value.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong experience in business development, technical sales, project sales, or solution selling within industrial process equipment or engineered systems.
  • Proven ability to develop new markets, build pipelines, and convert complex technical opportunities into successful projects.
  • Strong understanding of industrial process applications, customer decision-making, and project execution cycles.
  • Experience managing a sales team of 8-10 people, including team management, talent development, and performance evaluation.
  • Comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments in Southeast Asia and Oceania.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across geographically dispersed markets within the region.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Expertise in Mechanical Vapor Recompression (MVR) systems and related industrial process applications.
  • Strong capability in technical sales, project sales, solution selling, feasibility reviews, application assessments, and commercial negotiations.
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies across industrial sectors.
  • Knowledge of industrial process equipment and engineered systems.
  • Exposure to industries including Process Industry, Semiconductors, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Energy, EPCs, and OEMs.
  • Experience working with both direct sales engineer networks and distributor-led markets.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, manage opportunity pipelines, and drive revenue and profitability growth.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and structured pipeline management processes.
  • Understanding of project execution, commissioning, performance validation, and customer acceptance processes.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Ability to communicate confidently with both technical and senior commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to lead across functions without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, resilience, and customer focus.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building, coaching, and developing teams.
  • Ability to balance short-term performance delivery with long-term capability building.
  • Strong written and spoken English; additional regional languages are an advantage.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, multicultural, and regional business environment.

job.title: PSRO Pillar Head
job.description:
Executive recruitment company Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a global leader in premium pet nutrition. Our respected client is seeking a PSRO Pillar Head for a hybrid position based in BGC, Taguig.

The PSRO Pillar Head is responsible for the development and execution of the PSR channel's long-term sales and marketing strategy in the Philippines. This multi-faceted role is accountable for developing the roadmap to deliver accelerated growth and profitability required to achieve the country's 2030 ambitions.

The PSRO Pillar Head reports to the Market Head and is a member of the Philippine Management Team. The role is responsible for people management, including identifying talent needs, recruiting, hiring, and selecting talent. As a line manager, the position is responsible for setting priorities and providing solutions to achieve or exceed company, Sales Operations, and individual objectives. The successful candidate will serve as the company's ambassador in every interaction, both internally and externally, and will work effectively with all levels of PSRO account representatives, as well as external vendors and agencies.

Key Responsibilities
  • Understand the competitive dynamics of the pet food category, the boundaries of the market, the strengths and weaknesses of the company's brand, the strengths and weaknesses of key competitors, and consumer behavior to develop a holistic sales and marketing strategy that delivers profitable growth and cash. Develop the PSRO business by identifying and leveraging new opportunities for PSR sales and market share growth.
  • Lead the long-term Sales and Customer/Shopper Marketing strategy development and execution for the Philippines, aligned with the SEA cluster and Regional 2030 vision, with critical elements including:
    • PSRO Portfolio Strategy – Define how the portfolio should evolve based on category development, market trends, and consumer profiles, including portfolio innovations and renovations.
    • Pricing – Conduct a clear assessment of key internal and external factors to develop a focused two-year pricing strategy.
    • Route-to-Market – Maximize brand presence and availability in the Philippine market through effective trade activation campaigns and sales priorities.
    • Perfect Store Project – Increase brand visibility and physical availability across offline and online PSRO channels by driving category solutions through the Perfect Store concept.
    • Sales Efficiency – Build selling and negotiation capabilities, develop field visit standards, establish KPIs, evaluate sales performance and field force efficiency, and continuously refine sales strategies.
    • Key Account Management – Build productive relationships with key accounts to drive category development and execution excellence. Participate in top-to-top meetings and joint business planning with major PSRO accounts.
    • Shopper & Trade Marketing – Design and implement annual marketing plans that deliver profitable growth, positive ROI, and increased numerical distribution.
    • Category & Customer Marketing – Define category growth drivers for top accounts, including customized activations and annual marketing plans.
    • E-commerce & Omnichannel Development – Leverage e-commerce growth, implement best-in-class digital solutions, and drive customer recruitment and prescription through online services.
    • Sales Operations – Support the PSRO sales organization through effective systems, reporting, forecasting, KPI management, sales incentive programs, and customer trading terms while ensuring the efficient use of sales systems and IT tools.
  • Own and co-lead the S&OP+ process, including Demand Management Review, to align day-to-day operations with long-term strategic objectives and ensure sales forecast accuracy.
  • Lead and actively participate in global, regional, and local projects to maximize business value. Represent the Philippines in global workstreams and collaborate with regional and global PSR communities to promote effective communication and best practice sharing.
  • Work closely with the Vet Pillar, Pro Pillar, Marketing, and Supply teams to create a collaborative environment that enhances PSR sales growth.
  • Design and develop an effective organizational structure that addresses long-term capability gaps while delivering high performance and exceptional customer service.
  • Recruit, motivate, and develop a high-performing team through strong leadership, engagement, and retention while fostering a supportive, inclusive, and innovative work environment.

Key Qualifications
Education and Professional Qualifications
  • Graduate degree or relevant experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Strong sales background in a highly competitive environment.
Knowledge and Experience
  • Minimum of 8 years of managerial experience in an international FMCG company.
  • Solid experience in people management.
  • Advanced analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent in English.

job.title: Government Relations Specialist (East Malaysia)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services sector to hire a Government Relations Specialist, East Malaysia. This opportunity is based in East Malaysia.

Position Overview
The role spearheads strategic advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia. It directly contributes to strengthening justice system responses and advancing policy frameworks to protect vulnerable workers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and implement advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia, ensuring alignment with strategies set by the Government Relations Manager.

  • Provide strategic input to the Program Support Specialist on stakeholder engagement, advocacy and policy reform opportunities.

  • Guide the team to ensure strategic external engagements that lead directly to project outcomes.

  • Develop and implement advocacy strategies aligned with IJM’s Protection Model, Advocacy Goals and Program Goals for East Malaysia.

  • Develop strategy and plans to activate stakeholders to influence the government on forced labour and labour trafficking issues.

  • Prepare background, strategic insights, plans and briefing documents toward advocacy and engagements with government, private partners, local and global development communities.

  • Ensure East Malaysia strategies and insights are communicated regularly to the Government Relations Manager for integration into national policy and systems change strategies.

  • Adapt national level advocacy frameworks to the East Malaysia context.

  • Remain up to date on policy reforms, media reports and relevant trends on national and state levels.

  • Map and engage key stakeholders with influence over labour protection and anti-trafficking efforts in Sabah and Sarawak.

  • Identify, facilitate, and manage strategic collaborations with government, civil society, and private sector partners.

  • Represent the organisation in meetings, forums, and coalitions to promote justice system improvements.

  • Facilitate multi-stakeholder dialogues, roundtables, and joint initiatives to promote systemic change.

  • Contribute to the development of training materials and advocacy resources.

  • Document lessons learned and best practices for internal and external knowledge sharing.

  • Provide capacity-building trainings in collaboration with programme teams and relevant specialists.

  • Maintain comprehensive records of strategic relationships, project activities, and advocacy outcomes.

  • Track progress against advocacy goals and contribute to quarterly and annual reporting.

  • Engage in regular coordination meetings with the Government Relations Manager to ensure harmonisation of national and East Malaysian strategies.

  • Provide timely updates and flag emerging political or stakeholder issues.

Key Requirements

  • Qualifications & Experience

    • Master’s degree in relevant field preferred.

    • Bachelor’s degree in humanities, social work, law, human rights, international development or related field, or equivalent work experience.

    • At least 5 years of experience in project development and implementation with diverse government and community-based groups.

    • Capacity-building experience desirable.

    • Strong knowledge of current issues on human trafficking, forced labour, international trafficking instruments and labour trafficking laws.

    • In-depth knowledge of federal and state government structures and dynamics.

    • Proven ability to work well at an inter-personal level with government and non-government stakeholders.

    • Established experience in networking with stakeholders across community spectrum.

  • Technical / Functional Expertise

    • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

    • Fluent in spoken and written English and Bahasa Malaysia.

    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

    • Developed organisational and leadership skills, superior attention to detail, exceptional follow-through and accountability for results.

    • Excellent time management and ability to work effectively under deadline pressures.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound judgement.

    • Experience working independently in remote or decentralised settings.

    • Excellent interpersonal skills, cross-cultural communication, and ability to foster good working relations.

    • Flexible, enthusiastic, and willing to receive feedback and learn from others.

    • High level of honesty and integrity.

    • Courageous and humble servant leader.

    • Passion and commitment for the mission and theory of change.

job.title: PERM Director of Nursing
job.description:
Director of Nursing Services (DON)
 
Full-Time | Exempt
Schedule: 40 hours per week
Salary: $125,000-$150,000 annually
 
About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing Services (DON) to lead our highly regarded, 5-star rated skilled nursing center. Unlike many traditional long-term care settings, Brookhaven's intimate 12-bed nursing center offers the opportunity to build meaningful relationships with residents, families, and staff while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, quality outcomes, and person-centered care.

This is a highly visible leadership role for a nursing professional who enjoys being actively engaged with residents and staff while providing strategic direction for nursing operations. The Director of Nursing Services is responsible for the overall direction, administration, and clinical oversight of Nursing Services, including quality improvement, regulatory compliance, staffing, professional development, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President/Chief Operating Officer & Nursing Home Administrator, the DON plays a key role in supporting Brookhaven's commitment to excellence, dignity, and resident-centered care. While this position is primarily focused on leadership and oversight rather than routine floor coverage, the ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who is willing to step in and provide clinical support when needed.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Direct and oversee all Nursing Services operations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including Department of Public Health requirements.
  • Lead quality assurance and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee resident assessments, care planning, nursing documentation, and clinical outcomes.
  • Manage staffing, scheduling, recruitment, retention, and employee development.
  • Foster a culture of person-centered care, resident satisfaction, dignity, and respect.
  • Oversee infection prevention and control programs.
  • Collaborate with physicians, residents, families, and interdisciplinary team members to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain nursing policies, procedures, and standards of practice.
  • Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively.
  • Ensure employee safety, staff education, orientation, and ongoing training requirements are met.
  • Serve as a clinical resource and provide direct nursing support as needed.
  • Support organizational goals and participate in committees, strategic initiatives, and community activities.
  • Other related duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications
  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) from an accredited nursing program.

job.title: Marketing Officer
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a leading education and publishing company. Our respective client is seeking for a Marketing Officer who will be responsible for developing and executing strategic marketing initiatives that strengthen brand presence, drive product awareness, and support business growth. This position is also responsible for developing integrated marketing campaigns, analyzing market trends, supporting sales initiatives, and maximizing customer engagement in collaboration with the Business Unit and Corporate Marketing teams. This role will have a hybrid work arrangement in Quezon City and will be reporting to the relevant Business Unit and Corporate Marketing teams.
 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing plans and campaigns across digital, print, and on-ground channels.

  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer insights to identify business opportunities and improve marketing strategies.

  • Plan and oversee marketing activations, events, and school-based campaigns to generate leads and increase brand awareness.
  • Support sales teams by providing localized marketing programs, promotional materials, and sales enablement tools.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, ROI, and marketing metrics, and recommend improvements.
  • Assist in pricing analysis and marketing strategies that support business growth and profitability.
  • Build and maintain partnerships with external organizations for co-branding and marketing initiatives.
  • Manage assigned marketing budgets and ensure efficient utilization of resources.
  • Recommend marketing technologies and process improvements to enhance campaign execution.
  • Perform other marketing and business-related tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Development Communication, or any related field.
  • At least 5 years of relevant marketing experience.
  • Minimum of 1 year of supervisory or team lead experience.
  • Strong background in marketing strategy, campaign management, branding, and digital marketing.
  • Experience in market research, customer engagement, event management, and integrated marketing communications.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, planning, and project management skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and digital marketing tools.

job.description:

The ideal candidate will be highly strategic and data-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maximize resources, and deliver impactful marketing campaigns in a fast-paced, matrix organization. This role will have a hybrid work arrangement in Quezon City and will be reporting to the Business Unit General Managers.
 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic marketing plans for two business units, ensuring alignment with business goals and revenue targets.
  • Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, events, and activations from planning through execution.
  • Strengthen brand positioning by ensuring consistent messaging and market presence across all customer touchpoints.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer segmentation to identify growth opportunities and optimize product positioning.

job.title: Regional Manager (Southern)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Consumer Electronics industry to hire a Regional Manager. This opportunity is based in Johor.

Position Overview

Lead and oversee the sales, operational, financial, people, and customer service performance of multiple branches within the assigned region. Drive sustainable business growth and operational excellence while ensuring alignment with organisational standards, policies, and objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, plan, manage, and supervise sales strategies for all assigned branches.
  • Ensure the Company achieves its monthly sales targets.
  • Develop and implement strategic financial planning for branch operations.
  • Manage and control operational costs effectively and efficiently.
  • Ensure operating expenses remain within the budget and limits approved by the Company.
  • Monitor operational and financial performance and provide periodic reports to the Company.
  • Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, housekeeping, and workplace environment across all branches.
  • Ensure branch facilities are properly maintained and fully operational.
  • Ensure employees deliver service that meets the Company's quality standards.
  • Ensure all Company operations run smoothly, efficiently, and without disruption.
  • Ensure all operational processes comply with the Company's policies, SOPs, and established standards.
  • Implement and maintain consistent quality assurance across all branches.
  • Enforce the Company's disciplinary policies and standards among employees.
  • Conduct and manage disciplinary actions in accordance with the Company's policies and procedures.
  • Oversee recruitment to ensure all positions are filled with competent and qualified personnel.
  • Plan, coordinate, and implement employee training and development programmes on a regular basis.
  • Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction is consistently maintained.
  • Investigate and resolve customer complaints professionally and in accordance with the Company's procedures.
  • Ensure adequate inventory levels are maintained for all product categories.
  • Monitor and ensure all products meet the Company's quality standards.
  • Perform regional management services for branches assigned by the Company from time to time.
  • Prepare and submit operational, sales, financial, inventory, and human resource performance reports as required by the Company.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline.

  • Proven experience in regional, area, or multi-branch management.

  • Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and managing branch performance.

  • Experience overseeing operational, financial, inventory, and human resource functions across multiple locations.

  • Experience in recruitment, employee development, and performance management.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of sales strategy development and execution.

  • Experience in financial planning, budgeting, cost control, and expense management.

  • Ability to analyse operational and financial performance and prepare management reports.

  • Sound understanding of SOP compliance, quality assurance, and operational governance.

  • Experience in inventory management and product quality control.

  • Knowledge of customer service management and complaint resolution processes.

  • Ability to oversee branch facilities management and operational continuity.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management capabilities.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Strategic thinking with strong commercial acumen.

  • Effective decision-making and problem-solving abilities.

  • High level of accountability, professionalism, and integrity.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills.

  • Ability to lead teams, drive performance, and foster a customer-centric culture.

  • Adaptability and capability to manage multiple priorities across a regional portfolio.

job.title: (Retainer) Estate Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading holding company in the energy sector. Our client is seeking an experienced Estate Manager to lead the strategic and operational management of its plantation business. This Jakarta-based position offers an exciting opportunity for a seasoned plantation professional to drive business performance and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall plantation business strategy and operations.
  • Drive productivity, operational efficiency, and cost optimization across plantation assets.
  • Oversee plantation planning, cultivation, harvesting, maintenance, and sustainability initiatives.
  • Manage budgets, operational KPIs, and financial performance.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, environmental standards, and company policies.
  • Build and lead high-performing plantation teams while fostering continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Forestry, or a related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of experience in plantation operations, including managerial leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale plantation estates.
  • Strong strategic thinking, operational leadership, and commercial mindset.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Willing to travel regularly to plantation sites.

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a confidential client operating in the industrial estate sector. Our client is seeking an experienced Procurement Manager to lead strategic sourcing and procurement operations while driving cost optimization, supplier excellence, and procurement governance.

This position offers an opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and play a key role in supporting the company's operational growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full procurement lifecycle, including sourcing, supplier selection, contract negotiation, purchasing, and supplier performance management.
  • Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Drive cost optimization initiatives while maintaining quality, service, and compliance standards.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with internal policies and applicable regulations.
  • Prepare procurement reports, budgets, and performance analyses for management.
  • Lead and develop the procurement team while promoting continuous process improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of procurement experience, including at least 3 years in a managerial capacity.
  • Prior experience within an industrial estate, industrial park, property development, infrastructure, utilities, or similar environment is highly preferred.
  • Strong expertise in strategic sourcing, contract management, and supplier negotiations.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience using ERP or procurement systems is an advantage.
  • Good command of English is preferred.

job.title: Chief Investment Officer
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is partnering with a highly reputable Asset Management company in Indonesia to recruit an experienced Chief Investment Officer (CIO).

This executive leadership role is responsible for defining and driving the firm's investment philosophy, portfolio strategy, and overall performance across all managed funds. The CIO will oversee investment research, strategic and tactical asset allocation, portfolio construction, risk governance, and decision-making, while ensuring strict compliance with OJK regulations and internal investment policies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investment Strategy & Asset Allocation

  • Define and execute the firm's overarching investment strategy across Equity, Fixed Income, Money Market, and Multi-Asset portfolios.

  • Lead macroeconomic research, capital market outlook development, and top-down strategy formulation.

  • Establish strategic and tactical asset allocation frameworks to drive alpha and outperformance against benchmarks.

2. Portfolio Management & Decision-Making

  • Oversee portfolio construction, optimization, liquidity management, and concentration limits.

  • Chair Investment Committee meetings, review major investment proposals, and guide high-conviction decision-making.

  • Monitor portfolio risk, scenario stress testing, and performance attribution in partnership with Risk Management and Compliance.

3. Strategic Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and coach direct reports, including the Head of Equity, Head of Fixed Income, Portfolio Managers, and Analysts.

  • Cultivate a disciplined, research-driven, and high-performance investment culture.

  • Focus on talent retention, succession planning, and professional development within the investment team.

4. Risk Governance & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure all managed funds strictly comply with OJK regulations, fund mandates, and internal risk management parameters.

  • Partner closely with Risk, Compliance, Distribution, and Executive Management teams to maintain robust governance standards.

  • Conduct regular portfolio scenario analysis and stress testing.

5. Stakeholder Management & Business Growth

  • Present investment performance, portfolio positioning, and market outlooks to the Board of Directors, executive management, and institutional clients.

  • Engage with institutional investors, key distributors, and regulators to support fundraising and business expansion.

  • Represent the firm in industry forums, public events, and high-level client meetings.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Advanced degrees (Master's/MBA) are a plus.

  • Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience within investment management, capital markets, or buy-side financial institutions.

  • Industry Expertise: Strong track record in portfolio management and investment strategy with deep expertise across both Equity and Fixed Income asset classes. Direct experience within a licensed Asset Management company in Indonesia is highly preferred.

  • Licensing & Certifications:

    • Active WMI (Wakil Manajer Investasi) license is required.

    • CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) charterholder designation is highly desirable.

  • Leadership & Strategy: Proven track record of leading investment teams, managing senior multi-asset class professionals, and delivering consistent risk-adjusted returns.

  • Governance & Stakeholder Skills: Deep understanding of OJK regulatory frameworks and strong executive presentation skills for communicating complex market dynamics to Board members and institutional investors.

job.title: R&D Chemist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire an R&D Chemist. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

This role supports pilot-scale R&D trials in edible oil refining and modification, delivering accurate chemical and instrumental analysis to underpin process development. It plays a direct part in advancing the organisation's innovation agenda across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel and renewable fuels.

Key Responsibilities

You will contribute directly to the organisation's technology development by generating accurate analytical data, supporting both pilot- and lab-scale process trials, and participating in innovation projects across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel, and renewable fuels.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Assist to laboratory and pilot-scale trials in edible oil refining, modification and oleochemical processes.
  • Participate in the preparation, execution, monitoring and reporting of R&D experiments.
  • Conduct chemical and instrumental analysis with our state-of-the-art analytical equipment.
  • Validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Ensure proper calibration, maintenance records, and laboratory documentation are kept up to date.
  • Manage laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Lead the implementation of laboratory safety protocols (chemical handling, waste management, PPE compliance, risk assessments).
  • Ensure the analytical and sample preparation areas are fully compliant with HSE standards.
  • Conduct periodic safety training and ensure safe operation of all analytical equipment.
  • Work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners (universities, institutes, customers).

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Prior experience in a laboratory or R&D environment, ideally within edible oils, fats, oleochemicals or a related process industry.
  • Experience supporting or leading laboratory safety protocols and HSE compliance is advantageous.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong hands-on skills in operating, maintaining and troubleshooting analytical equipment.
  • Solid understanding of chemical analysis related to edible oils and fats (FFA, DOBI, peroxide value, fatty acid profile, moisture, stability, etc.).
  • Ability to validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and chemical management, including calibration, maintenance records and documentation.
  • Experience managing laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Accurate, detail-oriented and able to produce reliable analytical data under time constraints.
  • Strong critical thinking and structured reporting skills.
  • Ability to lead the implementation of safety protocols and conduct periodic safety training.
  • Effective collaborator, able to work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners such as universities, institutes and customers.

job.title: Technical Manager
job.description:
Technical Manager

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Technical Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Technical Manager will oversee the technical, financial and operational delivery of maintenance and project activities, ensuring works are completed to specification, on schedule and within budget. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding the organisation's operational integrity, regulatory compliance and long-term asset reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  1. To strictly follow and adhere to all Company policies and approved procedures on business ethics, SSHE and others.
  2. Manage the financial aspect of all maintenance works and projects following the approved budget.
  3. Responsible for the maintenance and project from inception to completion of jobs, meeting the technical requirement, schedule and budget.
  4. Liaise with Contractors and Consultants on various maintenance works and projects.
  5. Assist with requirements in relation to site preparation and associated consultations.
  6. To assist in procurement of spare parts, consumables and equipment and ensure that the procurement procedure is followed, meeting the technical specification and budget.
  7. To participate in technical discussions internally as well as with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities, during the tender review, technical clarifications and site meetings.
  8. To develop and execute a preventive maintenance plan on critical equipment and monitor the implementation.
  9. To attend to maintenance problems arising from daily operational activities.
  10. To plan, monitor, execute and maintain calibration records and certificates of fitness of critical equipment.
  11. To strictly comply with the Company's HSSE regulations when carrying out maintenance activities. In the absence of the Company's as well as government regulations on maintenance activities to be carried out, best practice rules apply.
  12. To play an active role in the Emergency Response Team, ISO9001:2008 and Safety Committee.
  13. Any other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the General Manager and immediate superior.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or professional qualification in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or a related discipline), or equivalent industry experience.
  • Proven experience in a technical/maintenance management role within an industrial, terminal or process operations environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing maintenance and project works from inception through to completion, including budget and schedule accountability.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of maintenance planning, project management and financial/budget control for maintenance and project works.
  • Experience in procurement processes for spare parts, consumables and equipment, ensuring alignment with technical specifications and budgetary requirements.
  • Proficiency in developing and executing preventive maintenance plans for critical equipment, including monitoring of implementation.
  • Experience in calibration planning, execution, record-keeping and maintaining certificates of fitness for critical equipment.
  • Sound knowledge of SSHE/HSSE regulations, company policies and best practice standards applicable to maintenance activities.
  • Familiarity with ISO9001:2008 quality management systems.
  • Experience participating in tender reviews, technical clarifications and site meetings with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and liaison skills, with the ability to engage effectively with contractors, consultants, customers, suppliers and authorities.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to respond promptly to maintenance issues arising from daily operations.
  • Strong organisational and multitasking abilities to manage competing priorities across maintenance and project portfolios.
  • High level of integrity and commitment to business ethics, safety and compliance standards.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for internal and external technical discussions.
  • Active and collaborative approach to emergency response and safety committee participation.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement, particularly in the absence of specific regulatory guidance.

· Directly manage and mentor a team of technical professionals, including Control Engineers responsible for programming/system logic and Project Engineers managing site progress and execution.
· Allocate resources effectively across multiple ongoing projects to maintain high utilization rates and ensure optimal team productivity.
· Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical or operational bottlenecks during project deployment.

Financial Control & Revenue Management

· Take full ownership of the project Profit & Loss (P&L), implementing strategies to optimize costs and maximize margins.
· Conduct accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasting for the department based on project milestones and execution progress.
· Monitor cash flow and ensure billing milestones are achieved and processed efficiently.
· Identify design, commercial and execution risks early to prevent delays and cost overruns.

Procurement & Subcontractor Ecosystem

· Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable subcontractors and suppliers for specialized project requirements (e.g., electrical works, mechanical piping, specialized BMS hardware).
· Oversee the procurement lifecycle: review and raise Purchase Requisitions (PRs) to ensure alignment with project budgets.
· Review, verify, and process subcontractor and supplier claims in a timely manner, ensuring all work meets quality standards before payment release.

Project Delivery, Compliance & Energy Optimization

· Ensure all projects comply with local engineering standards, safety regulations, and contractual obligations.
· Facilitate seamless coordination between the sales team, engineering team, and external vendors to ensure the original design intent (such as chilled water system optimization or control strategies) is flawlessly executed on site.
· Leverage energy management principles to ensure deployed systems meet or exceed efficiency targets, aligning with national standards like the EECA 2024.
· Ensure compliance with relevant standards (ASME, SMACNA & IEC) for ACMV project installation, testing and commissioning.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Control Engineering.
  • Registration as a Graduate Engineer or Professional Engineer with the Board of Engineers Malaysia is highly advantageous.
  • PMI PMP (Project Management Professional) active certification demonstrating global standards in project execution and risk management.
  • Registered Energy Manager (REM) Type 1 or Type 2 certification under Suruhanjaya Tenaga (Energy Commission).
  • Minimum 7–10 years of experience in project management or engineering fulfilment, specifically within the HVAC, Building Automation (BAS), or Energy Services sectors.
  • Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams of engineers and technical staff.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project P&L, budget forecasting, and complex procurement workflows.
  • Possess practical knowledge of ACMV equipment installation, operation and troubleshooting.
  • Possess general Malaysian construction contract knowledge, including PAM, PWD and IEM contracts, as well as claims, variation orders, EOT, LAD and defects liability.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC, Building Automation Systems (BAS), and Energy Services projects.
  • Experience in project financial management, revenue forecasting, budgeting, and cash flow monitoring.
  • Expertise in procurement lifecycle management, including Purchase Requisitions (PRs), supplier onboarding, and subcontractor administration.
  • Knowledge of specialized BMS hardware, electrical works, and mechanical piping systems.
  • Familiarity with energy efficiency and thermal optimisation requirements under EECA 2024.
  • Understanding of chilled water system optimisation and control strategy deployment.
  • Proficiency in project management software and financial tracking tools.
  • Working knowledge of ASME, SMACNA and IEC standards for ACMV project installation, testing and commissioning.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities with the ability to mentor and develop technical professionals.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across sales, engineering, vendors, suppliers, and subcontractors.
  • Strong negotiation skills for vendor and subcontractor management.
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating project risks.
  • High-level strategic mindset to navigate supply chain delays, project execution challenges, and commercial risks.
  • Strong organisational and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects effectively.
  • Ability to drive accountability, operational excellence, and high-performance project delivery.

job.title: Technical Specialist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Medical Device/ Equipment sector to hire an R2 Remote Engineer – APAC. This opportunity is based in Selangor.

Position Overview
This role serves as the primary technical escalation point for distributors and Field Service Engineers, providing advanced remote support for complex technical issues.
It plays a critical role in ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and high levels of customer support across the APAC region.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide Level 2 remote technical support for distributors and internal Field Service Engineers across the APAC region.
  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex product, system, and application-related issues.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, fault isolation, diagnostic analysis, and root cause investigations.
  • Coordinate with the Service Engineering team on high-level technical escalations and corrective actions.
  • Maintain ownership of assigned cases from escalation through resolution and closure.
  • Support distributor service organizations with technical guidance, troubleshooting assistance, and best practices.
  • Assist Field Service Engineers during complex onsite service activities and customer escalations.
  • Analyze system logs, diagnostic data, and service reports to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify recurring technical issues and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Participate in technical reviews, product updates, training activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development and sharing of technical knowledge across the regional service organization.
  • Maintain effective communication with all stakeholders and provide timely updates on escalation status and resolution plans.
  • Stay current on product enhancements, software releases, and technical documentation.
Job Requirement:
  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, Medical Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Min. 3 years of experience in Technical Support, Field Service, Service Engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues.
  • Experience supporting distributors, channel partners, or regional service organizations is preferred.
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, system logs, and diagnostic information.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and cultures.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote support environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Fluent in English; additional Asian language capabilities are an advantage.
  • Willingness to support stakeholders across different APAC time zones.

job.title: QSHE Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a QSHE Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

This role is responsible for maintaining, developing and continually improving the organisation's Quality, Safety, Health and Environment (QSHE) Management System in line with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and applicable Health & Safety legislation. It plays a critical role in embedding a strong safety culture and ensuring regulatory compliance across the site, directly supporting the organisation's operational integrity and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Job Purpose

To maintain, develop and continually improve all the company's QSHE Management System in accordance with ISO 9001; ISO 14001, the requirements of Health & Safety Legislation and any other requirements.

To ensure and arrange the provision of elementary Health & Safety training to all staff as required, including, but not limited to Risk Assessment, Manual Handling, Accident Investigation and Reporting, Hazard and Defect Reporting, Environmental Awareness and other relevant training needs as required.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Write, review & maintain local HSE and Quality System procedures, ensuring they are all available on the SharePoint.
  • Acting as a focal point for the site to ensure that global quality & SHE procedures and protocols are made available to, understood and completed by the relevant departments.
  • Communicate information related to QHSE to all the employees and promotes HSE awareness through various communication channels i.e. inductions, training, discussions, emails, etc. in consultation with all relevant departments.
  • Locally lead and maintain ISO9001:2015 accreditation.
  • Locally lead and maintain ISO 14001:2015 accreditation.
  • Locally lead and maintain Halal accreditation.
  • Locally lead any new accreditation in line with the CPL strategy.
  • Complete the annual internal audit programme for Quality & SHE, conducting audits including:
    • Internal Quality System audits
    • Hygiene audits in the laboratory and production areas
    • Safety auditing for fire, storage racking etc.
  • Complete SHE training for the site corrosives handling, standard operating procedures, fire procedures. Manage and arrange all trainings related to QSHE.
  • Interpret, build upon and comply with company policies and the recognised set of international standards.
  • Management of the annual programme of SHE risk assessments and follow up.
  • Co-ordinate internal and external Non-Conformance System. Liaise with the relevant departments to put in place corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence.
  • Recording, investigating and reporting to relevant level of management in accordance with our legal responsibilities of safety & environmental incidents and following up actions to prevent recurrence. Suggest and advise changes to ensure continuous improvement on any additional effective OFIs to be added as part of continual improvement.
  • Controlling both hazardous & non-hazardous wastes and keeping accurate records.
  • Ensure waste management procedures are always followed and all documentation required by law is received and all permits are current.
  • Ensure the workplace is free from hazards and excellent hygiene and housekeeping standards are maintained and meet expectations.
  • Complete supplier questionnaires, Long Term Supplier Declarations and other QSHE related requests from stakeholders.
  • Compilation of spreadsheets, graphs and reports on KPI's for discussion at management and performance review meetings.
  • Collation of utility consumption figures, along with compilation & publication of monthly graphs.
  • Develop, implement and encourage the behavioural based safety culture in the company through safe job observations.
  • Ensure compliance with the QSHE management systems, relevant Health, Safety & Environmental legislation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of core processes to ensure manufacturing QSHE is maintained while efficiency is optimised.
  • Support facilities management coordinator as and when required.
  • Adhere to the quality, environmental, health and safety standards of the company.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Candidate must be an SHO green book holder and possess a Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Safety & Health, or be certified by NIOSH or equivalent.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Up to date knowledge of all EHS / Authorities QHSE requirements.
  • Understanding of QSHE Risk Management tools would be an advantage.
  • High level of numeracy skills.
  • Knowledge and experience within Quality Assurance or Control procedures within a manufacturing environment would be a distinct advantage.
  • Knowledge and experience of Health and Safety in a manufacturing environment would be a distinct advantage.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • A friendly / helpful attitude.
  • Able to work efficiently and effectively with attention to detail, even when under pressure.
  • Customer oriented.
  • A highly organised and professional approach to managing a demanding workload.
  • A great team player with the ability to work with minimal supervision.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a European multinational organisation and world leader in developing, engineering and supplying technologies, processing plants and proprietary equipment for the Oils & Fats, Animal Feed & Agro Food, Oleochemicals, Biodiesel, Detergents, Surfactants and Chemicals sectors, to hire a Regional Project Engineer for their Industrial division. Engineering:

Plan and prepare project schedules, standard operating procedures (including safety procedures) and checklists for all projects and monitor the progress. Ensure all procurements are compliance with regulatory requirement and specifications.

Project Closure:

  • To ensure all the payment are collected.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Possess at least a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or related discipline.

Technical / Functional Expertise:

  • Strong technical aptitude.

  • Aspiration to advance into position of increasing responsibility.

job.title: Head of Quality
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting a Quality Head on behalf of a leading multinational dialysis service provider. The role will be responsible for leading clinical governance across the company’s hemodialysis clinics in the Philippines, ensuring the delivery of high-quality guest (patient) care, compliance with regulatory requirements, and continuous improvement of clinical practices. This is an onsite role based in Makati City.

About the role:
The Quality Head role leads clinical governance across the company’s hemodialysis clinics across the Philippines, ensuring the delivery of high-quality guest (patient) care, adherence to regulatory requirements, and continuous improvement of clinical practices.

This role is responsible for driving the national clinical quality agenda, implementing standardized processes, and strengthening guest (patient) safety initiatives.

This role oversees clinical standards, competency-based training programs, and quality management systems, including audits, performance monitoring, and data-driven reviews. It also collaborates with cross-functional teams to enhance clinical workflows, improve efficiency, and align clinical practices with organizational objectives.

In addition, the role provides leadership in developing and coaching clinical teams, fostering a culture of accountability, excellence, and consistent delivery of care across all locations.

Key responsibilities:
Clinical & Nursing Leadership
  • Provide national direction for nursing and clinical operations across all clinics.
  • Implement clinical standards, programs, and operational processes.
  • Oversee the development and execution of competency-based training for Hemodialysis Nurses.
Quality Management & Patient Safety
  • Lead the national clinical quality agenda and ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.
  • Develop quality improvement programs to enhance patient outcomes and safety.
  • Execute audits, quality metrics reporting, and data-driven performance reviews.
  • Champion patient and employee safety initiatives across the network.
Process Improvement & Clinical Governance
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance clinical workflows and operational efficiency.
  • Introduce process improvements that support both clinical and business goals.
  • Standardize procedures to ensure consistent delivery of care across all locations
Leadership & Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Lead, coach, and develop clinical teams to build high-performing, quality-driven operations.

Key qualifications:
  • Registered Nurse or licensed healthcare professional.
  • At least 10 years of experience in healthcare, clinical services, or quality management.
  • Strong background in clinical operations, quality systems, and regulatory standards.
  • Analytical thinker with proven ability to manage data, interpret performance metrics, and drive improvements.
  • Experience in dialysis, hospital, or specialty care settings is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Core Competencies:
  • Clinical governance & quality assurance
  • Strategic thinking & analytical decision-making
  • Process improvement & project management
  • Strong leadership & people development
  • Healthcare regulatory knowledge & compliance
  • Data-driven problem solving & performance analysis
  • Collaboration, stakeholder management & influencing skills
  • Effective communication and cross-functional coordination
  • Accountability, results orientation & ownership
  • Adaptability and continuous improvement mindse

job.title: Director of Operations
job.description:
Our client, a reputable international aviation services company, is seeking an experienced Director of Operations to lead, oversee, and continuously improve ground handling station operations in Indonesia. This role ensures high-quality, efficient, and safe operations that align with global standards, customer satisfaction, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be a strategic leader with a strong background in aviation operations management, safety, compliance, and cross-functional team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Operational & Strategic Leadership

  • Ensure the station provides efficient and high-quality service in line with international aviation and ground handling standards.

  • Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the company’s mission, safety, and customer satisfaction goals.

  • Oversee day-to-day operational, safety, and security activities at the station.

  • Represent the station to external stakeholders including airport authorities, government entities, and airline partners.

People & Performance Management

  • Lead, motivate, and develop a diverse operations team to achieve key business objectives.

  • Conduct regular performance evaluations and implement continuous improvement programs.

  • Foster a culture of safety, accountability, and excellence across all teams.

Budgeting & Resource Planning

  • Prepare and manage station budgets, ensuring effective resource utilization and cost control.

  • Plan and monitor manpower, equipment, and infrastructure needs for operational efficiency.

  • Analyze operational data and develop performance improvement initiatives.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure full compliance with aviation safety regulations and company standards.

  • Implement and monitor Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) frameworks.

The ideal candidate will play a key role in supporting the Human Capital function across Southeast Asia, acting as a reliable coordinator for HR processes and programs.   • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

job.title: Brand Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an executive search firm, is recruiting on behalf of a FMCG company. Our client is seeking a Brand Manager responsible for managing brand performance by overseeing sales, profitability, budgets, and P&L, while leading new product development, conducting market research, and developing and executing marketing strategies to drive brand growth and successful product launches. This role offers Hybrid work set up, with the office located in Quezon City.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Performance Tracking by setting annual sales and profit targets and management of A&P (advertising and promotions) / P&L (profit & loss) of the brand to ensure the brand is profitable
  • Budget Management by setting annual A&P budget and monitoring budget broken down monthly based on the total year A&P and actual monthly expenses.
  • New Product Development by preparing product/packaging briefs of a specific product, coordinating these with the New Product Development Group, preparing the launch plans and monitoring distribution, inventory and sales off take from time of launch.
  • Market Research/Studies by collecting business and economic data, conducting field study/surveys and analyzing/evaluating data gathered to develop marketing plan for the products handled.
  • Strategy Development & Execution Excellence by crafting strategies and yearly marketing plans for the brands/categories handled and timely implementation of activities.
Key job qualifications include:
  • Graduate of Marketing, Management or Communications or any related course
  • Must possess at least 4 years experience in product management in a manufacturing/fast moving consumer goods set-up.
  • Must be adept in budget planning and basic costing.
  • Articulate, detail-oriented, analytical and with good business acumen

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context

  • Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Quality Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

  • Oversee and drive all quality assurance and control activities within a manufacturing environment.
  • Ensure robust quality systems, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement to enhance operational performance and product reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all aspects of quality assurance and control within our manufacturing facility.
  • Ensures implementation and improvement of the quality part of the Integrated Management System (including process management) according to corporate quality strategy and respective local regulations.
  • Cooperates closely with relevant internal stakeholders across geographies, i.e. R&D, Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, corporate quality, etc.
  • Understanding customer needs and requirements to develop effective quality control processes.
  • Lead supplier quality activities including incoming quality, SCAR management, change control and capability evidence (Cpk).
  • Drive PFMEA, SPC and structured problem solving (8D, CAPA, DMAIC) to secure stable process performance.
  • Oversee all product development procedures to identify deviations from quality standards.
  • Plans, implements and follows up the audit programme (including certification audits where applicable) and assessments to ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements; copy exact experience will be a plus
  • Foster an open error reporting culture with early escalation, rapid containment and strong root cause prevention.
  • Prepare regular reports on quality performance for management review.
  • Provide leadership to cross-functional teams to resolve customer quality, product and application issues
  • Fosters team skills and motivation to achieve quality objectives

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 7 years of total work experience in relevant industries, of which at least 5 years is in Quality or Quality-related scope
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams
  • Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or similar discipline
  • Knowledge or direct exposure on wireless communications/RF engineering, PCB or equivalent related technical experience in fields of electronic test equipment preferred
  • Relevant experience in semiconductor manufacturing is a plus
  • Ability to develop a solutions-based approach in corrective measures for defective parts, failure rates from component to assembly
  • Ability to act as a catalyst for change and improvement in performance and quality
  • Good understanding of quality management system ISO 9001, Six Sigma and other quality methods
  • Expertise in PFMEA, SPC, Cpk/stability analysis and 8D/CAPA
  • Strong leadership, audit readiness skills and communication across suppliers and customers
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Quality assurance and control in manufacturing environments
  • Integrated Management System implementation and process management
  • Supplier quality management including SCAR, change control, and Cpk analysis
  • Structured problem-solving methodologies: PFMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, DMAIC
  • Audit programme planning, certification audits, and compliance assessments
  • Quality management systems including ISO 9001 and Six Sigma
  • Wireless communications/RF engineering, PCB, or electronic test equipment exposure
  • Semiconductor manufacturing knowledge (advantageous)
  • Data analysis related to failure rates, component performance, and assembly quality
  • Cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Purchasing
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities
  • Effective communication across cross-functional and multicultural teams
  • Customer-focused mindset with a strong understanding of quality requirements
  • Problem-solving orientation with a structured and analytical approach
  • Ability to drive change, continuous improvement, and performance enhancement
  • High level of accountability and audit readiness discipline
  • Collaborative and influential stakeholder management skills
  • Resilience and adaptability within a dynamic manufacturing environment

job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an executive search firm, is recruiting on behalf of a digital gaming and entertainment company. Our client is seeking a TA Lead responsible for driving end-to-end recruitment across key business functions in a fast-paced environment. End-to-End Recruitment
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across multiple functions and levels.

Talent Sourcing & Agency Management
  • Build talent pipelines through sourcing, referrals, market mapping, and agency partnerships.

job.title: Software Licensing Administrator - Engineering Consultant (Jakarta)
job.description:
Software Licensing Administrator - Engineering Consultant (Jakarta)
Executive recruitment company Monroe Consulting Group Indonesia is recruiting on behalf of a leading Multinational Engineering Consultancies company. As expansion continues, our client is seeking a professional with at least 5 years’ experience in software licensing for the job of Software Licensing Administrator. The job is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
Key job responsibilities include: 
  • Administer and manage software licensing across the company, ensuring software assets are legally licensed, accurately recorded, and managed in a compliant and cost-effective manner.
  • Maintain software asset management systems and records, including license entitlements, supplier information, renewal schedules, and usage data, to support auditability, compliance, and informed decision-making.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end software license lifecycle across business units, including acquisition, renewal, and retirement, working closely with Procurement, technical teams, and vendors.
  • Support financial and demand planning by forecasting license requirements, validating business needs, and ensuring alignment between license consumption, budgets, and contractual commitments.
  • Prepare purchase requisitions and support contract renewals to deliver timely, compliant, and value-for-money outcomes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for external software audits and conduct internal compliance activities, including identifying and remediating unauthorised software usage, to minimise financial and legal risk.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of software asset management and lifecycle practices, processes, and controls.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships and communicate professionally with colleagues, suppliers, and vendors to support operational delivery and business outcomes.
  • Contribute positively to team performance through collaboration, participation in operational activities and special projects, and alignment with organisational goals.
Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in ICT, or related discipline.
  • Proven experience supporting software renewals, compliance activities, audits, or procurement processes in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret software contracts, license terms, and usage metrics
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience desirable

job.title: Senior Food Waste Specialist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is representing a prestigious international initiative dedicated to sustainability and circular economy solutions. Our client is driving a major collaborative movement in Indonesia, GRASP2030, which focuses on transforming food systems, reducing food loss, and optimizing supply chain efficiencies. They are currently seeking a highly skilled and culturally fluent technical expert to lead field implementation and data-driven interventions across the country.


Job Purpose

The Senior Food Specialist will lead the design and delivery of technical workstreams for GRASP2030 and related projects in Indonesia. Operating within a collaborative, multi-partner consortium model, this role provides hands-on technical capabilities across retail, manufacturing, processing, and hospitality/food service environments.

 

The successful candidate will act as a central delivery engine—generating high-quality evidence, supply-chain hotspot analyses, and operational insights to help businesses, funders, and strategic partners eliminate food waste and improve environmental performance.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Delivery & Evidence Generation: Lead technical assessments, operational diagnostics, intervention designs, and waste audits across diverse business environments. Utilize data measurement tools, digital capture systems, and dashboards to collect and present reliable evidence that meets strict accuracy standards.

  • Field Implementation & Project Management: Work directly with businesses to execute on-site pilots, trials, and case studies in settings like hotels, restaurants, canteens, factories, and waste facilities. Develop comprehensive workplans, operational protocols, and risk management frameworks while supervising external field enumerators or data collectors when necessary.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Behaviour Change: Build trusted, culturally grounded relationships with Indonesian businesses at all levels—from frontline staff to senior executives. Facilitate workshops and training sessions to embed long-lasting behaviour changes and improved operational practices within local organizational contexts.

  • Consortium Collaboration & Advisory: Maintain close coordination and alignment with local partner networks (including IBCSD), technical partners, and international donors to manage overlapping priorities. Provide evidence-based insights to advise on future project designs, funding prospects, and scaling options.

  • Communication & Reporting: Produce clear, accessible technical reports, case studies, and data summaries for corporate, government, and funding stakeholders. Deliver confident communications in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Environmental Science, Food Technology, Sustainability, Engineering, Public Health, or a related technical discipline. A postgraduate qualification is desirable but not required.

  • Experience & Technical Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding of Indonesia’s food system challenges, specifically regarding food loss and waste across supply chains. Exposure to circular economy frameworks, packaging materials, and climate impacts is highly valued.

  • Languages: Native or professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia is required , alongside strong, professional English proficiency.

     

  • Key Skills: Ability to translate field findings into concrete business recommendations. Familiarity with digital data capture systems or basic GHG emissions calculations relevant to supply chains is a distinct advantage.

  • Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in food safety, waste auditing, GHG accounting, or Lean/Six Sigma are considered an asset.

  • Mobility & Dynamics: Must be based in Jakarta , willing to travel within Indonesia for field implementation , and comfortable managing regular virtual meetings with international teams across different time zones.
